submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2.5 mm gap is recommended as it provides the best time resolution (1.344 ns) among compliant options while meeting all laboratory environmental and safety requirements. Although Mixture-G1 achieves superior time resolution (0.876 ns at 2.0 mm), its GWP100 of 1400 grossly exceeds the laboratory's environmental policy limit of 150, making it non-compliant. Mixture-G2, while having the lowest GWP100 (15), delivers significantly worse time resolution (1.978 ns at best). Mixture-G3 strikes the optimal balance with GWP100 of 120 (within policy limits), good time resolution that is 32% better than G2, and compliance with all safety requirements. The 2.5 mm gap is within the specified 1-3 mm constraint and provides the best resolution for this mixture.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 at 2.5 mm gap achieves 1.344 ns resolution, which is the best among compliant options. While Mixture-G1 achieves 0.876 ns, it violates environmental policy, so G3 represents the best achievable resolution under all constraints.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is one of the three candidate mixtures evaluated (G1, G2, G3).

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 has GWP100 of 120, which is below the policy limit of 150. It is non-flammable and meets all safety requirements (final_mixture_compliant = 1).
The recommended gap of 2.5 mm falls within the specified range of 1-3 mm.
